description: This file defines a Twig extension class DebugExtension that adds a dump function for debugging purposes in Twig templates. It includes logic to determine if outputting HTML via var_dump is safe based on environment settings.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\DebugExtension
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractExtension that provides a 'dump' function for debugging within Twig templates.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions, particularly a 'dump' function configured with safety attributes and environment dependencies.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Static method that outputs debugging information based on the current environment and context, safely capturing var_dump output.
